content.json:
# 🔄 AKS Arc — Fleet Pod Restart

Use this workbook to restart a Kubernetes workload (**Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, or Pods**) across one or many AKS Arc connected clusters simultaneously.  
Restarts are executed by the `Master-FleetRestart` Azure Automation runbook via a direct ARM job PUT — no Logic App required.

**Workflow:**  
1. Fill in **Connection Settings** (one-time, save the workbook after).  
2. Set the **Workload Target** (namespace, type, name).  
3. **Select Clusters** — or leave all rows unselected to target every connected cluster.  
4. Review the summary and click **▶ Start Fleet Restart**.  

---

> ⚠️ **RBAC required:** Your account must have `Automation Operator` (or higher) on the Automation Account to create jobs.

> ℹ️ **Audit log:** Per-cluster results appear in the `AKSArcRestart_CL` Log Analytics table within ~2 minutes of job completion.

---

### ⚙️ Connection Settings

Enter these once — they point the workbook at your Automation Account and Log Analytics workspace.

parameters.name: AASubscriptionId
parameters.label: AA Subscription ID
parameters.description: Subscription ID (GUID) that contains the Automation Account, e.g. e858a6b1-b4df-4533-98bf-8af3688e5f01

parameters.name: AAResourceGroup
parameters.label: AA Resource Group
parameters.description: Resource group that contains the Automation Account, e.g. RG-LogicApp-Mass-Pod-Restart

parameters.name: AAAccountName
parameters.label: Automation Account Name
parameters.description: Name of the Azure Automation Account, e.g. aa-aks-pod-restart

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.label: Log Analytics Workspace
parameters.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"
| project value = id, label = strcat(name, " (", resourceGroup, ")")
| order by label asc
parameters.description: Select the Log Analytics workspace that receives the AKSArcRestart_CL audit logs

content.json:
---

### 🎯 Workload Target

Specify the Kubernetes workload to restart. The same workload name is applied to every selected cluster.

parameters.name: WorkloadName
parameters.label: Workload Name
parameters.description: Exact name for Deployment/StatefulSet/DaemonSet. For Pod type: a label selector, e.g. app.kubernetes.io/name=my-api

parameters.name: PodDeleteMode
parameters.label: Pod Delete Mode
parameters.jsonData: [{"value":"Sequential","label":"Sequential — safe, 2 s gap between pod deletions"},{"value":"Parallel","label":"Parallel — fastest, all pods deleted simultaneously"}]

parameters.name: InitiatedBy
parameters.label: Initiated By (audit label)
parameters.description: Optional. Recorded in the audit log. Defaults to your AAD UPN if left blank.

content.json:
---

## Step 1 — Select Clusters

Check the clusters to include in the restart.  
**Leave all rows unchecked to target every connected cluster** (full fleet restart, 800+ clusters).  
Use the column filter icons or the search row to narrow by name, resource group, environment tag, or location.

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.kubernetes/connectedclusters"
| where properties.connectivityStatus == "Connected"
| extend environment = coalesce(tostring(tags.environment), tostring(tags.Environment), tostring(tags.Env), "")
| extend k8sVersion = tostring(properties.kubernetesVersion)
| project name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, environment, location, k8sVersion
| order by name asc
content.title: Connected AKS Arc Clusters

parameters.name: NewJobId
parameters.label: Job GUID (auto-generated)
parameters.description: Auto-generated from Log Analytics. Click ⟳ between restarts in the same session to get a fresh GUID.

parameters.name: ClusterFilter
parameters.label: Cluster Filter KQL (auto — computed from selection)
parameters.description: Auto-built KQL fragment passed to Master-FleetRestart as -ClusterFilter. Empty = target all clusters.

content.json:
---

## Step 2 — Review & Launch

Verify the parameters below before submitting. All values are substituted live.

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| **Workload Type** | {WorkloadType} |
| **Namespace** | {Namespace} |
| **Workload Name** | {WorkloadName} |
| **Pod Delete Mode** | {PodDeleteMode} |
| **Initiated By** | {InitiatedBy} |
| **Selected Clusters** | {SelectedClusterNames} |
| **Cluster Filter (KQL)** | {ClusterFilter} |

> ℹ️ If **Selected Clusters** is blank, the job targets **all** connected clusters.

armActionContext.description:
## ▶ Confirm Fleet Restart

You are about to create an Azure Automation job to restart the following workload:

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| **Workload Type** | {WorkloadType} |
| **Namespace** | {Namespace} |
| **Workload Name** | {WorkloadName} |

content.json:
---

## Step 3 — Monitor Active Jobs

Aggregated view of restart jobs from the last 2 hours, sourced from the `AKSArcRestart_CL` audit table.  
Scroll down for the full per-cluster audit log.

content.query:
AKSArcRestart_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| summarize
    StartedAt     = min(TimeGenerated),
    TotalClusters = dcount(ClusterName_s),
    Succeeded     = countif(Status_s == "Success"),
    Failed        = countif(Status_s == "Failed"),
    Skipped       = countif(Status_s == "Skipped"),
    Running       = countif(Status_s == "Started")
  by JobId_g, InitiatedBy_s, WorkloadType_s, WorkloadName_s, Namespace_s
| extend OverallStatus = case(
    Running > 0,  "Running",
    Failed  > 0,  "Completed (errors)",
                  "Completed")
| project
    StartedAt,
    JobId        = JobId_g,
    Workload     = strcat(WorkloadType_s, "/", WorkloadName_s, " (", Namespace_s, ")"),
    Status       = OverallStatus,
    Clusters     = TotalClusters,
    OK           = Succeeded,
    Failed,
    Skipped,
    Running,
    InitiatedBy  = InitiatedBy_s
| order by StartedAt desc
| take 10
content.title: Recent Restart Jobs (last 2 h)

content.json:
---

## Step 4 — Audit History

Per-cluster restart results from `AKSArcRestart_CL`. Adjust the time range to see older data.  
`Status` is color-coded · `DurationMs` shows a heatbar · `ErrorDetail` is populated on failures.

content.query:
AKSArcRestart_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where "{AuditStatusFilter}" == "value::all" or Status_s == "{AuditStatusFilter}"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ClusterName  = ClusterName_s,
    Namespace    = Namespace_s,
    WorkloadType = WorkloadType_s,
    WorkloadName = WorkloadName_s,
    Status       = Status_s,
    HttpStatus   = toint(HttpStatus_d),
    DurationMs   = DurationMs,
    InitiatedBy  = InitiatedBy_s,
    JobId        = JobId_g,
    ShardId      = ShardId_s,
    ErrorDetail  = ErrorDetail_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Audit Log — Per-Cluster Restart Results
